images.title: A shell holds the empty place
images.purpose: Shows 361 in Mayan numerals: one dot, a shell, one dot, stacked from top to bottom.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One vertical stack of three places in the centre with place names on the right and the number below.
images.exact_structure: A vertical stack of three places separated by thin grey (#6B7280) lines. Top place: exactly 1 dark dot. Middle place: exactly 1 seashell symbol in reddish purple (#CC79A7). Bottom place: exactly 1 dark dot. To the right of each place, small teal (#0072B2) labels, top to bottom: 360s, 20s, 1s. Below the stack, centred: 361. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: The Mayans drew a shell wherever a place was empty: 361 is 1, shell, 1.

image_decisions.why: The stacked places with a shell show the placeholder in action.
